visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a glass display case filled with Hunter x Hunter anime figurines. A man with long dark hair, wearing a grey cap and a purple-toned patterned shirt, gestures toward the display while talking excitedly. (2) He stands in a well-lit retail environment surrounded by shelves of merchandise. He holds up a prize reference sheet and points to specific characters like Neferpitou, his face showing high energy and anticipation. (3) The scene shifts to a table where the man's hands are seen peeling open several purple Ichiban Kuji lottery tickets. He reveals prize letters such as H, G, and C. (4) After drawing a 'C' prize, he celebrates by holding a large boxed figurine of the character Kite. He walks through the store aisles, smiling and looking into the camera. (5) He continues opening various prizes, including posters of the Phantom Troupe and small rubber straps. He holds these up to the camera to show the details of the character designs. (6) In the final phase, he unboxes a small plastic blind-bag item, revealing a 'Morel' desktop mascot. He shows the figure close-up to the camera and provides a concluding commentary with a satisfied expression.
